messages:
maria_cs: Hey team — kicking off the privacy/security questionnaire handoff for BrightHorizon (renewal in ~3 weeks). I uploaded the customer's DPA questions and a short evidence checklist. Can SE/Eng confirm where the infra diagram, KMS attestation, and log retention table live? We need a complete package by end of week.

sam_se: Got it — downloading now. Do they want BYOK details or just supported KMS providers list? I can produce both. @kevin_security any known compliance blockers for BrightHorizon?

onboarding-bot: Uploaded files: dpa_questions.xlsx, evidence_checklist.md (2 files) :white_check_mark:

kevin_security: We have a KMS attestation doc but it's the internal copy (contains IPs). I'll redact and generate a customer-friendly version. Also need to confirm non-prod data flow diagrams — those are split across two repos.

maria_cs: Thanks. Quick timeline: if SE can drop infra diagram by 14:00 and security can upload redacted KMS attestation + log retention table by 16:00 we can assemble and send a partial package to the customer, then follow up with any outstanding items.

sam_se: Will do. Infra diagram path I'll use: 
```
git clone git@github.com:redwood/infrastructure-diagrams.git 
cd diagrams && ./export_for_customer.sh --project bright-horizon --redact-private
```
I will attach the exported PDF to this thread when ready.

kevin_security: Plan: pull attestation from GDrive, run redaction script, and upload to S3 presigned link. ETA ~16:00. Command I'll run: 
```
python scripts/redact_sensitive.py --input attestation_internal.docx --output attestation_customer.docx --remove-ips --mask-ids
aws s3 cp attestation_customer.docx s3://redwood-evidence/brighthorizon/attestation_customer.docx --acl private
```
I'll include a short note about what was redacted.

jess_legal: One note — the DPA addendum we last used was v1.3. Customer's questionnaire references BYOK language; legal needs to confirm whether we apply v1.3 as-is or require product sign-off for updated BYOK wording. Tagging product for approval.

linda_product: Quick check from product: BYOK phrase is fine with a small addition about key rotation cadence. I'll paste the suggested sentence here in a minute.

maria_cs: Action list (summarized):
- sam_se: infra diagram + exported PDF (by 14:00)
- kevin_security: redacted KMS attestation + log retention table (by 16:00)
- jess_legal + linda_product: confirm DPA addendum/BYOK wording (ASAP)
If any item slips, we'll send a partial package + SOC2 scope note and schedule a short call with the customer.

sam_se: Uploaded infra-diagram-BH-2026-03.pdf to thread (link: https://files.redwood.com/diagrams/infra-diagram-BH-2026-03.pdf) :paperclip:

kevin_security: Uploaded attestation_customer.docx to S3 presigned link (sent via DM to maria_cs). Log retention table attached here as CSV. Note: retained logs for 90 days across prod; archival policy described in column D.

jess_legal: Confirmed — v1.3 addendum applies but we'll add the rotation cadence sentence from product. I'll mark DPA as draft and request signature after package assembled.

linda_product: Suggested sentence: "Customer-managed keys must be rotated at minimum every 12 months; operational rotations more frequently are permitted." Okay to add? :+1:

maria_cs: Perfect — assembling the packet now. If everything stays on schedule I will send to BrightHorizon with a cover note and a request to sign the addendum. Thanks everyone, will post the final package here when sent. :rocket:

maria_cs: Sent package at 17:24 (partial + note on pending items). Customer asked for a short call next Tue to review BYOK flow. I'll create the invite and DM calendar to attendees.

sam_se: Acked, standing by for call prep.

kevin_security: Closing our deliverables; flagging one follow-up: customer asked for sample KMS policy snippets — I can prepare those pre-call.

maria_cs: Great. Closing thread for now, will reopen if customer requests more evidence.
